title: Cold workspace-save publication must not block unrelated mailbox lookup on full-state projection
outcome: A cold-load workspace save preserves its exact commit cut while unrelated local mailbox validation can proceed independently of deferred full-state projection; the existing snapshot repair is adopted rather than duplicated.
acceptance: A source note on the declared revision maps cold-load workspace PUT, local mailbox validation/listing, overview/backfill and persistence lock boundaries, distinguishes a state-lock waiter from a holder, and records that the historical 7.1-second event has no retained holder attribution. Existing snapshot and ACK repairs are reused rather than reimplemented; unrelated candidates remain explicitly unproven.

A deterministic regression drives a real workspace PUT and local mailbox-session validation with connected production persistence and broadcast paths. With deferred full-state projection paused after its immutable commit-cut capture, the workspace response and unrelated mailbox validation complete without waiting for that projection. The pre-fix path fails at a lock-scope assertion; no sleeps, wall-time pass threshold, fabricated durability or synthetic load establishes the result.

Workspace layout contents, label preservation, layout/global revisions, persistence acknowledgement policy and exact snapshot-before-delta publication order are preserved. Mailbox local-root/delegation/hidden-session checks and pending/ownership rules are unchanged; concurrent session mutation cannot mix the published commit cut.

Host-recorded focused regressions and the maintained full gate pass on the exact final source input, with an independent whole-input Codex/Claude pair free of outstanding Medium or higher. This source child establishes the cold-load route lock-scope contract; historical incident attribution, client first-paint behavior and any live latency claim remain separate and require independent evidence.
